test_title: PYST 10 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 15 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentence parts to form a meaningful and grammatically correct paragraph:

P. The perfect gift appeared on her screen, so she clicked to add it to her cart.

Q. She typed in her address and credit card details, then checked out.

R. With a final click, her order was placed and confirmed.

S. Now she waits for the package to arrive at her doorstep.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The paragraph follows a chronological sequence of an online shopping experience, moving from item selection to final delivery anticipation.
 
• **Sentence P is the first sentence** as it initiates the narrative by identifying the object and the first action:
 
 
• "The perfect gift appeared on her screen, so she clicked to add it to her cart."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q follows** as the next logical step in the e-commerce process, which is providing the necessary information for the purchase:
 
 
• "She typed in her address and credit card details, then checked out."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R is the third sentence** because it describes the finality of the digital transaction:
 
 
• "With a final click, her order was placed and confirmed."
 
 
 
• **Sentence S is the fourth** as it represents the aftermath of the action—the period of waiting after the order has been successfully processed:
 
 
• "Now she waits for the package to arrive at her doorstep."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **PQRS**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement**:

"The perfect gift appeared on her screen, so she clicked to add it to her cart. She typed in her address and credit card details, then checked out. With a final click, her order was placed and confirmed. Now she waits for the package to arrive at her doorstep."
